0022600110.text: The Denver Nuggets, 0-1 and 10th in the West, host the New Orleans Pelicans, also 0-1 and 9th in the West, in a game that is the Nuggets' second of the season. Denver is missing Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain), Julian Strawther (knee sprain), and Spencer Jones (hamstring), all listed as out, while Alpha Diallo (wrist) is day-to-day and a game-time decision; New Orleans is listed without Yves Missi (knee), who is also day-to-day and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but Denver won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 122-116 win in New Orleans on January 13, 2026.
